abstract: BACKGROUND: Testicular cancer (TC) patients have a high survival rate, and the question of post-therapy recovery of sperm production and its dependence on genetic predisposition is of major interest. METHODS: Ejaculates were obtained from 112 TC patients at one or more of the following time points: post-orchidectomy, or 6, 12, 24, 36 and 60 months post-therapy. The lengths of the androgen receptor (AR) function modulating CAG and GGN repeats in leukocyte DNA were also analysed. RESULTS: No significant decrease in sperm concentration was seen in men who received 1-2 cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy (ACT). Radiotherapy (RT) or more than two cycles of chemotherapy (HCT) caused an initial decline in sperm concentration, which returned to pre-treatment levels 2-5 years after therapy. In the HCT group, sperm concentration 12-24 months post-treatment (T(12-24)) was inversely correlated with CAG length (rho = -0.72, P = 0.03). The type of treatment, but not the concentration at T(0), was an independent predictor of sperm concentration at T(6) (P < 0.0005) and T(12-24) (P = 0.004). CONCLUSION: ACT did not induce a significant decline in sperm concentration. After HCT and RT, a significant reduction of sperm concentration was observed, recovering to pre-treatment levels 2-5 years post-treatment. In HCT-treated patients, the AR CAG length influenced the recovery of spermatogenesis.
abstract_ja: 「背景：精巣がん（TC）患者は生存率が高く、治療後の精子産生の回復と遺伝的素因との関係が重要な課題である。方法：112例のTC患者から、精巣摘除術後、または治療後6、12、24、36、60か月の時点で射精液を採取した。白血球DNAにおけるアンドロゲン受容体（AR）機能を修飾するCAGおよびGGNリピートの長さも解析した。結果：補助化学療法（ACT）を1〜2サイクル受けた患者では精子濃度の有意な低下はみられなかった。放射線療法（RT）または2サイクルを超える化学療法（HCT）では、精子濃度が一時的に低下し、治療後2〜5年で治療前の水準に回復した。HCT群では、治療後12〜24か月の精子濃度がCAGリピート長と負の相関を示した（rho = -0.72, P = 0.03）。治療前の濃度ではなく治療の種類が、T(6)およびT(12-24)の精子濃度の独立した予測因子であった。結論：ACTでは精子濃度の有意な低下は起こさなかった。HCTおよびRTの後には精子濃度の有意な減少がみられ、治療後2〜5年で治療前の水準に回復した。HCT治療患者では、AR CAGリピート長が精子形成の回復に影響した。」
